2921-5267-7924.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a Clue.
Ulvenwald Mysteries' second ability triggers, creating a Clue token due to Flitwing.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat.

883-4279-5075--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
883-4279-5075--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent, Ogre Slumlord and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6972-8095-8174.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Mabel.
When Mabel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Mabel enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

2436-4613-4687.easyPrerequisites: Gilder Bairn is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
2436-4613-4687.notablePrerequisites: Marwyn has a +1/+1 counter on it and has power 3 or greater.

147-3085-5147.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3085-5147.description:
Cast Zombify by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Zombify.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Zombify
Resolve the Zombify copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2829-4419-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2829-4419-4694-7306.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2033-3249-4976--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2033-3249-4976--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Open the Graves triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

225-851-4772-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1274-2034-3490-7818.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-2034-3490-7818.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life.
Heliod triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

240-413-5434-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-6972-7160.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Arcbound Whelp.
When Arcbound Whelp dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Whelp's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Whelp from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

4050-4488-7084.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Rampaging Baloths triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

539-997-2783-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters, Nesting Dragon triggers, as Bladewing's Thrall is a land due to Ashaya.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the Dragon Egg enters, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-4112-4375.description:
Cast Sharuum either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{W}{U}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Sharuum enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Technomancer.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Sharuum.
Resolve the Sharuum trigger, returning Technomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Technomancer.
Resolve the Technomancer trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

678-2060-5231-6759.description:
Cast Broodguard Elite for its warp cost by paying {1}{G}.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Broodguard Elite, adding {R}.
When Broodguard Elite dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Broodguard Elite trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Broodguard Elite from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

2292-3086-3175.description:
Cast Lagrella by paying {G}{W}{U}
When Lagrella enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Sun Titan until Lagrella leaves the battlefield.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Lagrella.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Sun Titan is returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it and Lagrella triggers.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Lagrella from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Viscera Seer abilities.

1339-2122-2445-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2122-2445-5231.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Insect, adding {R}.
Repeat.

524-1167-5049.description:
Activate Mindslaver by paying {4} and tapping it, causing you to gain control of target opponent during their next turn.
During the opponent's turn, cast Aether Storm by paying {3}{U}.
As the opponent, activate Aether Storm by paying 4 life.
Repeat step 3 until the opponent has 3 or less life remaining.

372-3647-4125.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Displace exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-3647-4125.description:
Cast Displace by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Shipwreck Dowser and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Shipwreck Dowser trigger.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Displace.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Shipwreck Dowser and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

4499-4893-5419.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Kalain.
When Kalain enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1987-4377-4423-4823.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-4377-4423-4823.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Timeless Witness.
When Timeless Witness and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Walk the Aeons from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons during your draw step.
Repeat.

5200-5709.notablePrerequisites:
Rofellos does not have summoning sickness. You control at least four Forests.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Rofellos
5200-5709.description:
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Rofellos
Repeat.
5200-5709.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may equip Sword of the Paruns to any creature you control and untap them infinite times.

uses.n: Shaile, Dean of Radiance // Embrose, Dean of Shadow

2178-2201-5622.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Embrose.
Embrose does not have summoning sickness.
2178-2201-5622.description:
Activate Embrose by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, then dealing 2 damage to that creature.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Embrose, untapping Embrose.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.
You may also repeat this loop targeting creatures you control to get extra card draw, if desired.

1069-2457-2837-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-2457-2837-5499.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Cat.
Activate the Cat by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may repeat step 1 as desired.

2034-2049-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ogre Chitterlord, adding {C}{C}.
When Ogre Chitterlord dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Ogre Chitterlord from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Ogre Chitterlord enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Rat creature tokens and giving Rats you control +2/+0 until end of turn if you control five or more Rats.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Rat, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1339-2804-3311.notablePrerequisites:
Snake Umbra attached to Witty Roastmaster.
You have a way to draw a card.
1339-2804-3311.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Witty Roastmaster, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Snake Umbra triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1530-4248.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is five or less.
An opponent cannot block Harnessed Snubhorn.
1530-4248.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Harnessed Snubhorn.
Harnessed Snubhorn triggers, returning Second Chance from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

1168-1651-2922-5077.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Scaretiller and another artifact, targeting Scaretiller.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Obscura Storefront from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Obscura Storefront enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Toggo.
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a Rock equipment token.
Resolve the Obscura Storefront trigger, causing you to sacrifice it then search your library for a basic Island, Plains, or Swamp and put it onto the battlefield.
If you put a land onto the battlefield this way, Toggo triggers, creating a Rock equipment token.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability from step 1, untapping Scaretiller.
Repeat.

878-1651-3094-4659.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature with power one or greater.
878-1651-3094-4659.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Ziatora triggers, causing you to sacrifice another creature with power one or greater.
Ziatora triggers, holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Ziatora's ability.
Resolve the copy of Ziatora's ability, dealing damage equal to the sacrificed creature's power to any target and creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasure tokens, untapping Lithoform Engine.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Treasure token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Ziatora's ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1308-1687-3389-4050.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}, attaching it to Siona.
Siona triggers, creating two 1/1 Human Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Human Soldier tokens, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

147-2034-4499-5219.description:
Cast Cabaretti Charm by paying {R}{G}{W}.
Holding priority, activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, copying Cabaretti Charm.
Resolve the copy of Cabaretti Charm, creating two 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing both Citizen tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

656-2034-2399-3693.notablePrerequisites: At least one +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
656-2034-2399-3693.description:
Sacrifice Walking Ballista to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}.
Colfenor triggers, returning Ugin's Conjurant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ugin's Conjurant for {1}.
Sacrifice Ugin's Conjurant to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}.
Colfenor triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Walking Ballista for {2}.
Repeat.

2-7.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
2-7.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {0}.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
